item.title: ‘The Huntress’ Tracks the Desire for Vengeance
item.description: The Huntress casts aside simplified ideas about revenge and observes different ways to respond to a culture of misogynistic violence.

item.title: Wes Craven’s Artfully Dreadful Voice of Horror
item.description: In Wes Craven's horror films, the victim is linguistically trapped before being physically pursued – conversation itself becomes the killing ground.

item.title: Jill Scott’s New Music Is As Vibrant As Ever
item.description: Jill Scott's new album fits seamlessly with pop's retro-futuristic fascination with the 1980s. Her signature mix of poetry, hip-hop, jazz, and soul is as vibrant as ever.

item.title: MetalMatters: Best Metal Albums of January 2026
item.description: In January's best metal, Ulver return to their deep electronica, the Ruins of Beverast show off their extreme black/doom, and Zu join free-jazz madness with ambient bliss.

item.title: Anselm Kiefer Exhibit at SLAM Evokes Beauty and Dissolution
item.description: Anselm Kiefer’s recent exhibit at SLAM explores beauty where fresh and salt waters meet, but I cannot see the river as a refuge, as Kiefer does, only as a threat.

item.title: Boy Golden Finds the Best Things in Life
item.description: Boy Golden has given us a soundtrack for good times, which is an achievement that, in our current world, feels nothing short of miraculous.

item.title: Melissa Aldana Creates Ideal Latin American Balladry
item.description: The overall sensation of Melissa Alada's Filin is not just beauty but distillation. The songs, even those without sung lyrics, get definitive interpretations.

item.title: Daphni Lights Up the Dancefloor with Sparkling Beats
item.description: Daphni's Butterfly is made to get you moving, designed for the club, but it will sound equally as massive in the living room discos.

item.title: My Most Anticipated Films of 2026
item.description: As surely as "Dumpuary January" follows the fall awards season, a new year brings a slew of anticipated films. If the industry is in trouble, nobody has told these directors.

item.title: 10 Should-Be-Classic Anxious Love Songs
item.description: Anxious love songs typically involve conflict—around unrequited passion, cheating, or loss—where the singer often feels something unresolved.
